description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She broke something small that mattered to her: a mug, a charm, a cracked mirror.
hub: She is gluing something back together, badly.
lines: My mug. The chipped one. It finally gave up.
Don't laugh. It was the only thing I owned that wasn't issued.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She found something odd and kept it: a pre-Bloom coin, a toy soldier, a key to nothing.
hub: She is turning a small object over in her fingers.
lines: Found this in the garage wall. A coin. Older than the company.
It's a key. To what, I don't know. I like that.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Someone went through her things while she was out.
hub: She is checking her locker, item by item.
lines: Someone's been in my locker. Nothing's missing. That's worse.
I fold my shirts a certain way. Someone didn't.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She brought back a photograph or a data chip from before the Bloom: strangers smiling in a world that is gone.
hub: A faded photograph is propped against her lamp.
lines: A family at a beach. Before. Look how bored they are. Look how safe.
I don't know who they are. I can't throw them away.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She found an old recording that still plays.
hub: A tinny old song leaks from her quarters.
lines: Found a music chip in a dead terminal. Ninety years old. Still works.
The singer's probably dust. Her voice isn't.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She changed something about how she looks: a scarf, a patch, an earring.
hub: There is something new about her uniform.
lines: Traded two ration cards for this scarf. Worth it.
It's a small thing. It's mine.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She cut her hair, or had it cut, or let it down for once.
hub: Her hair is different today.
lines: Cut it myself. Don't say anything.
Felt like being someone slightly different. Hair's the cheap way.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Nothing has happened for days and she is climbing the walls.
hub: She is bouncing a ball against the wall, over and over.
lines: If nothing happens soon, I'm going to start a fight for fun.
I've cleaned my rifle four times today. Four.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The weather has got into her mood.
hub: She watches the weather from the window.
lines: Rain all day. Either I sleep or I scream.
It's so hot the walls are sweating.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She wrote in her journal tonight, longer than usual.
hub: She closes a notebook as soon as anyone looks.
lines: Writing. No, you can't read it.
Some things only make sense on paper.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She had a nightmare and has not shaken it off.
hub: She looks like she slept badly.
lines: Bad night. The tank again.
I woke up with my hand on my knife. Don't ask.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: For once she slept through the night.
hub: She seems rested, almost cheerful.
lines: Eight hours. No dreams. I feel new.
I don't know what happened, but I slept like the dead. The nice dead.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She is ill: a fever, a bad stomach, a construct cold.
hub: She is wrapped in a blanket, sniffing.
lines: Even off-spec bodies catch colds. Who knew.
Medbay says rest. Medbay is boring.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A wound from the last run has closed into a new scar.
hub: She is studying a fresh scar in the mirror.
lines: New scar. Left shoulder. It'll go with the others.
Medic says it'll fade. I hope it doesn't. I earned it.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She pulled something or bruised herself in training.
hub: She is walking a little stiffly.
lines: Twisted my ankle on the yard. My own fault.
Don't make me laugh. Ribs.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: An old wound aches in the cold.
hub: She rubs an old scar absently.
lines: The old one's acting up. Rain's coming.
My knee is a better weather forecast than oversight.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Her implants misbehaved: a stutter, a lost minute, a flicker in her vision.
hub: She keeps blinking, as if clearing her eyes.
lines: Lost about ninety seconds this morning. Just... gone.
My HUD said I was underwater. I was in the shower.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She had a corporate firmware update or a deep scan and does not feel quite the same.
hub: She sits very still, as if listening to something inside.
lines: They patched me last night. Everything feels a little to the left.
I keep checking my memories, like pockets after a pickpocket.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She cried alone, where nobody would see.
hub: Her eyes are a little red.
lines: Allergies.
I'm fine. Really.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Today is the anniversary of her decanting, the closest thing she has to a birthday.
hub: She is quieter than usual today.
lines: Some people have birthdays. I have a batch date. It's today.
Seven years out of the tank. Nobody brought cake. I'm not hinting. I'm hinting.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A memory surfaced that she cannot place: a room, a voice, a song from before.
hub: She stops mid-step, staring at nothing.
lines: I remembered a kitchen. I've never been in a kitchen like that.
There was a woman humming. I don't know who she was. I think she knew me.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: News reached her about the corporation that made her: a recall, a scrapped batch, a new model.
hub: She is reading the same corporate bulletin again and again.
lines: They retired my batch. All of them. I'm a discontinued model now.
New line of units out. Faster than us. Of course.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A letter reached her through the corporate post: rare, censored, from someone outside.
hub: She keeps rereading a folded letter.
lines: Got a letter. Half of it's blacked out. The other half I've read forty times.
Someone out there still knows my number. Weird feeling.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Another woman got a letter; nobody wrote to her.
hub: She watches the mail drop and walks away.
lines: Who'd write to me? I was born in a tank.
It's fine. I don't need letters.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She argued with another woman of the squad.
hub: She is avoiding someone and making a point of it.
lines: Don't put me next to her at dinner.
She's wrong and she knows it. I'm waiting for her to say it.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She made peace with the woman she argued with.
hub: She is laughing with someone she was avoiding yesterday.
lines: We talked. We're fine. Don't make a thing of it.
She brought me coffee. I'm not made of stone.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She sat up half the night talking with another woman of the squad.
hub: She yawns, looking oddly content.
lines: We talked until the generators switched. About nothing. It was good.
I learned more about her in one night than in a year of patrols.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Another woman gave her a small gift.
hub: She is wearing something new that someone gave her.
lines: She made me a bracelet out of wire. It's terrible. I love it.
Got a present. For no reason. Suspicious. Nice.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Someone brushed her off or forgot her, and it stung more than it should.
hub: She is short with everyone today.
lines: Nothing. It's nothing.
Some people only remember you when they need something.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The squad's leader praised her in front of the others.
hub: She stands a little straighter today.
lines: She said I did well. In front of everyone.
Don't tell anyone it got to me. It got to me.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She had a row with the quartermaster over supplies.
hub: She is muttering about requisition forms.
lines: Three forms for a pair of socks. Three.
I'm going to requisition the quartermaster's head.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She heard a rumor and cannot stop turning it over.
hub: She is whispering with someone in the corridor.
lines: Did you hear? No? Then I didn't tell you.
Probably nonsense. Probably.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A mission is coming and she cannot settle.
hub: She checks her gear for the third time.
lines: I've packed and unpacked twice. Normal. Totally normal.
Day before a drop, I can't eat. Day after, I can't stop.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A grunt died and she cannot let it go.
hub: She is sitting alone near the vehicle bay.
lines: Nobody even knew her name. I did. I asked.
They'll print a new one. Same face. It's not the same.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Today marks the day someone she lost died.
hub: She has set out two cups instead of one.
lines: A month today. Feels like a year and a minute.
I keep her tag in my pocket. Today I'm holding it.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She received a formal reprimand.
hub: She is glaring at a printed form.
lines: Written up. For being late to a briefing about punctuality.
Another mark in my file. They can frame it.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She heard that a transfer or a reduced contract might be possible for her.
hub: She seems distracted, hopeful, trying not to be.
lines: There's talk of a transfer list. I'm not getting my hopes up. I'm getting my hopes up.
If it's true, I could be out in a year. If.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Her weapon jammed or broke on the range.
hub: She has her rifle in pieces and a scowl.
lines: Jammed three times on the range. If it does that in the field, I'm dead.
Workshop says two days. Two days naked.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She won a sparring bout and is pleased with herself.
hub: She is grinning and rolling her shoulders.
lines: Put her on the mat in ten seconds. A new record.
I'm not bragging. I'm reporting.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She lost a sparring bout and it rankles.
hub: She is replaying a move in the air, scowling.
lines: She got me with the hip throw. Again.
Rematch. Tomorrow. I'm not asking.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She saw Bloom growth closer to the fence than it should be.
hub: She keeps glancing toward the perimeter.
lines: There's growth on the east fence post. It wasn't there last week.
It's creeping closer. Nobody's mentioned it. So I am.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Rations were short or bad today.
hub: She is staring at her tray with loathing.
lines: Today's protein is gray. Not gray-brown. Gray.
Half rations again. My stomach has filed a complaint.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She finished a book and is still inside it.
hub: She is holding a closed book, not ready to put it down.
lines: Finished it. The ending was wrong. I want to argue with someone.
Done. Now I don't know what to do with my evenings.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Her plant did something new.
hub: She is crouched by her window, looking at a tin of soil.
lines: New leaf. Don't laugh.
It's leaning toward the light. Smart plant.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She got something right in her hobby that she has been trying for weeks.
hub: She looks quietly proud of something.
lines: I finally got it. Three weeks. Finally.
Want to see? No, really, watch.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She cooked something from almost nothing.
hub: The smell of something actually good drifts from the mess.
lines: Made soup out of ration powder and spite. It's edible. It's good, even.
Come taste this before I lose my nerve.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A song is stuck in her head and she is humming it all day.
hub: She is humming under her breath.
lines: It's been in my head since dawn. Make it stop. Don't make it stop.
You'll have it too by tonight. Sorry.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She found an animal near the base: a stray cat, a bird with a hurt wing.
hub: She has crumbs in her pocket and a secret.
lines: There's a cat by the east fence. Don't tell supply.
Found a bird with a bad wing. I'm calling her Sergeant.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She won at cards and is insufferable about it.
hub: She is counting a small pile of cigarettes and ration chits.
lines: Cleaned them out. Ask me how. Skill.
I'm rich. In cigarettes. I don't smoke.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She lost at cards and owes someone a chore.
hub: She is scrubbing something that is not her job.
lines: I owe a week of latrine duty. Don't ask.
Never bet against a medic. They count everything.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She dreamt of the commander and is not sure what to do with it.
hub: She glances away when the commander looks at her.
lines: I had a dream. You were in it. That's all I'm saying.
Weird night. Never mind.
